bio.text: Dianne Hart-Lowman represents District 63 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Democrat, elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.
Hart-Lowman was born in Tampa, lives there, and is CEO of the East Tampa Business and Civic Association and a business owner.
Hart-Lowman holds a B.S. in human services from Springfield College (2017).

sources.title: Dianne "Ms Dee" Hart-Lowman - Florida House of Representatives
